Bill.BriefDescription: Providing excise tax exemptions for districts providing water service that have three hundred connections or less.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to excise tax exemptions for districts providingwater service that have three hundred connections or less; adding a newsection to chapter 82.04 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 82.16RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: This chapter does not apply to amounts received for water servicessupplied by a public utility district under Title 54 RCW, a watersewerdistrict established under Title 57 RCW, or an irrigation districtestablished under Title 87 RCW, that has less than three hundredconnections.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.16 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: This chapter does not apply to amounts received for water servicessupplied by a public utility district under Title 54 RCW, a watersewerdistrict established under Title 57 RCW, or an irrigation district p. 1 SB 6146established under Title 87 RCW, that has less than three hundredconnections.
